item.title: A New-Generation Of F-16 Operations In Europe
item.description: Branded Content: A new training center, F-16 Viper (F-16V) upgrades, and new-build Block 70/72 variants hail the second-coming of the Fighting Falcon in Europe. The post A New-Generation Of F-16 Operations In Europe appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: Company Behind Drone-Killing Hellfire Missile-Armed Buggy Set To Get Marine Corps Contract
item.description: The Denied Area Sprinter-Hellfire system offers Marines a new highly mobile way to defend against drones and potentially other aerial threats. The post Company Behind Drone-Killing Hellfire Missile-Armed Buggy Set To Get Marine Corps Contract appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: KC-46 Mishap Closes Key European Logistical Hub For U.S. For Days (Updated)
item.description: The KC-46 mishap at Moron Air Base in Spain comes as the U.S. is flowing military resources to the Middle East ahead of a potential attack on or from Iran. The post KC-46 Mishap Closes Key European Logistical Hub For U.S. For Days (Updated) appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: F-35 From USS Abraham Lincoln Shoots Down Iranian Drone (Updated)
item.description: The F-35C acted to defend the supercarrier from the drone after it approached the ship while operating far out to sea. The post F-35 From USS Abraham Lincoln Shoots Down Iranian Drone (Updated) appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: F-15EX Buy Dropped By Indonesia
item.description: With Rafale deliveries underway, Indonesia has stepped away from its previous plan to buy up to 24 F-15EX Eagle IIs. The post F-15EX Buy Dropped By Indonesia appeared first on The War Zone.

item.description: The Turkish F-16s arrived in Somalia as fighting with al-Shabaab extremists heats up. The post Turkish F-16 Vipers Seen Operating Out Of Mogadishu’s International Airport appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: Evidence Of Mi-28 Havoc Attack Helicopters Delivered To Iran Grows

item.title: Department Of Homeland Security’s New Gulfstream Jet Now In Service
item.description: Two new Gulfstream 700s are joining the Coast Guard's older GV and G550 aircraft in the Long Range Command and Control Aircraft role. The post Department Of Homeland Security’s New Gulfstream Jet Now In Service appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: Meteor Long-Range Air-To-Air Missile In The Works For Ukraine, But There’s A Catch
item.description: The ramjet-powered missile would allow Ukraine to challenge Russian fighters within their own long-range missiles' engagement zones. The post Meteor Long-Range Air-To-Air Missile In The Works For Ukraine, But There’s A Catch appeared first on The War Zone.

item.title: Navy’s T-45 Replacement Will Not Be Capable Of Making Carrier Landing Touch And Goes
item.description: The Navy has already axed carrier qualifications for new pilots, but now even practicing carrier touchdowns on land will be off limits with its new jet. The post Navy’s T-45 Replacement Will Not Be Capable Of Making Carrier Landing Touch And Goes appeared first on The War Zone.
